name: 本地 Whisper 有界转录
eligibility_checks: FFmpeg, ffprobe, and Whisper CLI are installed
an explicit local model checkpoint exists
assumptions: the local checkpoint is compatible with the installed Whisper runtime and selected audio clip
human_gates: review speakers and transcript semantics before content claims
diagnostics: clip bounds, extraction and transcription return codes, checkpoint hash, package version, empty/repeated/low-logprob/high-no-speech candidates, and failures
allowed_claims: the local checkpoint produced the recorded transcript candidate for the declared bounded clip
forbidden_claims: a model may be downloaded automatically
a failed model may be retried automatically
